image_description: A weasel (likely a stoat or short-tailed weasel) captured in mid-stride running across green grass. The animal has a slender, elongated body with brown dorsal fur and white ventral fur. Its head is turned slightly towards the viewer, showing a pointed snout and small dark eye. The legs are short and tucked under the body due to the motion. There is a visible watermark text overlay across the center of the image.

artifact_observations.reasoning: There is a semi-transparent watermark text ('© Terri...') overlaid on the subject. While likely intentional in the source photo, in AI generation contexts, text overlays often indicate training data leakage or attempt to mask structural flaws. It is legible but constitutes an artifact in the context of pure image generation evaluation.

Significant motion blur is present on the hindquarters. While this mimics photographic motion blur, AI generators often struggle with limb extremities during motion, resulting in 'melting' into the background. The boundary between the hind paw and the grass is soft and indistinct.

The transition between brown and white fur is somewhat sharp but lacks individual hair strand definition in the mid-body region, appearing slightly airbrushed or painted rather than naturally textured.
